rework_notes: Review rejected the previous attempt. it does not conform to the Contract: The new _persisted_ids query does not exhaust Supabase pagination: if the pending-insert batch exceeds the response limit, committed inserts omitted from that page are marked persisted=False and reported as not saved. This violates the Contract's requirement not to report pre-closure committed changes as unsaved; the added single-insert tests do not cover this case. it does not conform to the Constitution: The supplied architecture assigns session-scoped card loading to card-service and specifies that collaborative-canvas calls that service to load cards. Adding a direct cards-table query in canvas._persisted_ids, without session scoping, moves this persistence read across that architectural ownership boundary.
